title: Drake: Scary Hours — Zohaib Qaiser
description: A browser-based tactical first-person shooter. Survive eight escalating waves at a sunset harbor terminal, choose stackable augments and face a three-phase powered-exoskeleton boss. An offline game by Zohaib Qaiser.
